title: Storage packing and layout
why: EVM packs multiple small variables into 32-byte slots; pallet-contracts stores SCALE-encoded values in a child trie. The oracle compares storage in count mode, but packing bugs in either compiler can surface as mismatched entry counts or values.
hints: Several adjacent uint8/bool/int32 fields written in different orders.
Struct with mixed-width fields (note: structs cannot cross the spec arg boundary — use internal helpers).
Mapping with uint8 keys vs address keys.
Delete a storage variable after setting it (zero-stripping edge cases).
bytes/string shorter and longer than 32 bytes.
